about: Whether a device is a browser all the way back to the root: what may make a team's owner or editor, or take a browser or a phone off an account. The device itself must be a browser certificate; each link before it a browser or a recovery code (the person's own, which only browsers make); the chain must end at the pinned root, self-signed. Every certificate kept for an id on the way is looked at, not only the one that made it trusted, so one more from control can only refuse. Signatures aren't checked here (ask Trust::evaluate whether the device is trusted at all). The app's old browser certificates (named "Arugula app ...") pass: control refuses their new papers by is_browser on every link.

cases.about: a browser a recovery code let in
the recovery code itself: it doesn't stand for a browser
the app's browser certificate from before it had a kind: passes here
a self-signed browser that isn't the root
the phone, with one more certificate for it from control, approved by the CLI
63 browsers down a chain from the root: 64 devices

input: account, root: what's pinned; certs: the account's, by label; device: the device's id
output: ok: whether it's a browser all the way to the root
